title: Tom DeLonge email to John Podesta about General McCasland
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Tom DeLonge email to John Podesta about General McCasland, about 2015-2016 at Washington, D.C., and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Buried in that email dump is an email from Tom Dong to Podesta. The subject line, General McCassland Dong writes, he mentioned he's a skeptic. He's not. I've been working with him for 4 months.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that among the emails of John Podesta, a Washington political figure, which were leaked and published by WikiLeaks, a website that posts leaked documents, there is one from a man named Tom DeLonge with the subject line "General McCasland." According to Michels, DeLonge writes that the general had said he was a skeptic, but he is not, and that DeLonge had been working with him for four months. If true, it would suggest a senior military officer was quietly helping DeLonge around 2015 or 2016.
